name: Italiauno
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Discover Italiauno in Ehrwald

** **

Welcome to Italiauno – your Italian-inspired escape in the heart of the Tirol Alps!

** **

Authentic Italian Flair in the Mountains

** **

Nestled in the picturesque village of Ehrwald, just a short drive from Innsbruck, Italiauno brings the charm of Italy to the Tirol countryside. Whether you're craving fresh pasta, crispy Arancini, or a perfectly brewed espresso, our menu is a love letter to Italian cuisine—with a touch of Alpine freshness.

** **

Indulge in Italian Classics

** **

From handmade Tagliatelle al Tartufo to golden-fried Cotoletta alla Milanese, every dish is crafted with passion. Don’t miss our famous Tiramisù or a warm plate of Risotto alla Milanese—because even in the mountains, Italian flavors shine.

** **

Relax & Enjoy the View

** **

Our cozy terrace offers breathtaking views of the Karwendel mountains, making every meal an experience. Sip on a glass of Prosecco or a rich Espresso while soaking in the crisp Alpine air.

** **

Sweet Endings

** **

No Italian meal is complete without dessert! Treat yourself to fluffy Cannoli, creamy Panna Cotta, or our signature Torta della Nonna—because even in Tirol, life is sweeter with a little Italian magic.

** **

Visit Us

** **

Find us in the charming village of Ehrwald, where Italian warmth meets Alpine hospitality. Whether you're here for a romantic dinner, a family feast, or just a taste of Italy, we’re your gateway to la dolce vita in the Tirol.

** **

Buon appetito!

**
